Property Play: Homes become mini data centers
There's been a lot of pushback in local communities against data centers. One company's answer: put small version on the side of your home. Apparently Nvidia and a major public homebuilder are helping them do it. CNBC's Diana Olick joins 'Squawk Box' with the details.
